notes: CAUSE: core/src/supabase.mjs completeJob writes status done, the only completion status any Core queue writer stores (ops_agent_jobs.status is unconstrained text; the Worker's mapReceipt in workers/mccluster/src/ai/build-code.js maps done to a display state, it stores nothing). coverageStatus in core/src/actors/coverage.mjs put a preview's outcome into status only when status === 'completed', so every finished preview projected as a bare done: a withheld preview and one awaiting owner review looked the same, against the PR document's promise to keep them distinct. The PR's unit test hid it with a hand-written row whose status was completed.

FIX (0001): status passes the queue's word through unchanged (queued, running, done, failed), and preview_outcome carries output.status for a done row and is null otherwise. The existing unit test's row now carries done and the test asserts both fields: its withheld assertion moved from status to preview_outcome and an assertion that status is done was added; nothing was removed. The planner fixture's completed became done; the planner skips an item with any prior row, as already_tracked unless the row is failed at max attempts (retry_exhausted), so done and completed are planned the same way and that test's behaviour is unchanged (precision corrected by the independent verification). Two sentences of docs/control-plane/ACTOR-COMMENTING-EVIDENCE-AND-COVERAGE.md now use the queue's words and name preview_outcome.

CONTRACT (0002): core/test/actor-coverage-queue-contract.test.mjs plans three news items with the real planner, enqueues them twice (the stable ids keep one row each) plus an owner preview, and runs the real claimNext, prepareClaimedDagJob, actorCommentPreview (production defaults except the model), buildCompletionEvidence and completeJob or failJob in runner.mjs order. coverageStatus then reads the rows as stored, read back through the real rest(). Outcomes reached: withheld thin_context_abstained, withheld source_unavailable (the article was removed after planning), needs_owner_review, and a source read answering 503 that is queued again and then failed when exhausted. The retry's backoff is passed by moving only that row's run_after; status and output are always the writer's. The coverage view is then fed back to the planner as existing jobs.

Kept unchanged, observed: the default needs_review for a done row without output.status is unreachable through the writer (mutant M4 survives) and is not one of the two outcome words. coverageStatus reads input.kind and input.item_id, which recentJobs() in core/src/supabase.mjs does not select, so a future Control caller must read the rows with input, as the contract test does with select=*.

An earlier draft of the contract test moved the clock with node:test mock timers. They need Node 20.11 or later and print an experimental warning, and scripts/deploy-ovh-core.sh runs this suite on a host whose Node is unrecorded, so the draft was changed before cutting. The synthetic model replies use a neutral fixture id instead of the configured model's name. Every log in evidence/ was produced from the final commits.
Each commit is green on its own: commit 1 alone passes npm run check and the Core suite 475/475 (evidence/core-suite-commit1.log).
